# Aceternity UI

- Reference https://ui.aceternity.com for effects: spotlight, aurora background, card hover glow, bento grids, marquee, text reveal.
- Built on Tailwind + Framer Motion; in vanilla CSS reproduce with gradients, radial masks, backdrop-filter and CSS animations.
- Use sparingly: one or two hero effects per page, keep performance high (transform/opacity only).
- Always honor prefers-reduced-motion.
